title: GNOME workspace switch causes false "Cline encountered an error" notification despite successful prompt
body:
### Cline Surface

Desktop App

### Cline Version

0.0.48

### Beta version

- [ ] I am using a beta version of Cline

### What happened?

On Fedora Linux with GNOME (Wayland), switching to a different workspace immediately after sending a prompt causes a false error notification: "Task Failed: Cline encountered an error while running this task" appears even though the prompt completes successfully without any issues.

The expected behavior is that the prompt should continue running in the background without showing an error — the notification appears to be triggered erroneously by the workspace switch itself, not by any actual problem with the prompt execution.

### Steps to reproduce

Open Cline Desktop App (v0.0.48) on Fedora Linux with GNOME (Wayland)
Send a prompt to Cline using Deepseek v4 pro
Immediately after sending (within ~1–2 seconds), switch to a different GNOME workspace (e.g., via Ctrl+Alt+Arrow or three-finger swipe gesture on trackpad)
Observe the notification: "Task Failed: Cline encountered an error while running this task"
Switch back to the original workspace — the prompt has actually completed (or is still running) without any real error
Provider/Model: deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro (justera gärna om du använder en annan provider)


### Provider/Model

cline:Deekseek/Deepseek-v4-pro

v0.0.48

Operating System: Fedora Linux 44
Hardware: SAMSUNG ELECTRONICS CO., LTD. 960XHA

Desktop Environment: GNOME 50 on Wayland
Workspace Switching: Ctrl+Alt+Arrow / three-finger swipe gesture
